section_summary.evidence_source: The study sample comprised 3621 undergraduate females from a large publicly-funded institution located in the Southeastern United States. The mean age was 19.4 years (SD = 1.5) and the sample was predominantly White/European American (62%) and Black/African American (21%). The participants had an average body mass index (BMI) of 23.5 kg/m2 (SD = 4.9; "normal weight" range) with 26.8% of the sample classifying as higher weight with a BMI ">= 25 kg/m2 (i.e., "overweight" and "obese").
